business.rationale: Decision: keep the starting artifact unchanged (legal option). Rationale: there is zero archived diagnostic evidence (probe_feedback is null, historical_observations empty) and the case id is "P-empty", so I have no observation supporting any specific modification. The only registered probe is whitespace normalization of generated plan text; the current _fmt() already emits clean, tightly parenthesized strings with single ASCII spaces and no edge whitespace, so that probe contract appears inapplicable to this source — a verdict of "unknown" rather than "supported". I also see plausible latent weaknesses (goal_satisfied ignores the actual goal set and returns [] immediately when all nuts start non-loose; pickup does not guard pre-existing carried state; empty plan returned when no men/man_loc), but with 0/8 development successes and no observations I cannot distinguish which matters, and speculative edits risk making the artifact worse without evidence. Submitting the original complete source verbatim. Uncertainty: high; no claim of improvement or success is made.
